name: MicDao sale contract sells at a fixed rate and adds its USDT as liquidity at the spot ratio
summary: The MicDao sale contract's unverified swap(uint256,address) sells MicDao at a fixed 10 per USDT and pairs the buyer's USDT with MicDao at the MicDao/USDT pool's spot ratio via addLiquidity. With 500,000 flash-loaned USDT the attacker pumped MicDao from 0.1 to about 84 USDT, bought 20,000 MicDao for 2,000 USDT through each of 80 fresh helper contracts, so the sale added 160,000 USDT against only 1,895 MicDao, then sold all its MicDao back and took 12,260 USDT of the pool's reserve.
notes: Before the attack the pool priced MicDao at 0.1 USDT (17,813 USDT against 177,869 MicDao), equal to the sale rate, so the defect is the spot-ratio liquidity add, not a below-market sale price; the per-caller limit the helpers suggest is not verifiable from the unverified bytecode.

Campaign: campaign.mjs over every swap() call since deployment finds only the anchor; the 41 earlier calls were EOA purchases of 1 to 2,000 USDT. Loss is the pool's net USDT outflow; the sale contract's MicDao is valued at nothing (rule 12).
